# v1.8.1 — presentation only

No new features. This release changes how existing figures are presented.

- **Registration headline.** Beside the raw no-match share, the panel shows, with equal prominence, the share for payloads launched more than two years before the snapshot date (rolling, recomputed daily), citing Jakhu, Jasani and McDowell (2018) 143 Acta Astronautica 406, 409.
- **Per-State table** sorted by number of payloads, with both shares as columns; States are not ranked by no-match share.
- **Registration ledger** (formerly "Registration Lag Index") moved to the bottom of the Registration panel with the line "Too early to support findings; see Section 4 for scope."
- **Phones.** Close controls are 44 px tap targets, a long object card no longer pushes its close button off the screen, the per-State table scrolls, and the QA gate now checks the object card and About at two phone sizes.
- "Cite this instrument" footer link; release workflow follows Zenodo's redirect; the lag.json migration shim is removed.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/hallamburnapp-cloud/stars-observatory/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

Code: MIT. Data and snapshots: CC BY 4.0.
